description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests related to managing devices in parental control settings, including enabling/disabling managed devices, allowing/blocking all devices, adding/editing/deleting individual device rules with conflict detection, and related utility functions.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Validates if a value exists within a specified array of allowed values.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a configuration parameter string to a specified value.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration parameter string.

methods.name: addTblObj
methods.description: Adds a new table object instance for device configuration.

methods.name: delTblObj
methods.description: Deletes a specified table object instance.

methods.name: getInstanceIDs
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs for a given object path.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values for multiple device instances.

methods.name: printableCharacters
methods.description: Validates if the input string contains printable characters.

methods.name: is_allowed_string
methods.description: Checks if a string is allowed based on security or formatting policies.

methods.name: validMAC
methods.description: Validates if the input string is a proper MAC address.

methods.name: time_date_conflict
methods.description: Checks for conflicts between two time/day rules.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_set
methods.description: Converts user input times and days to UTC or internal format.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_get
methods.description: Converts stored schedule times back to user format.
